items.Sentence: The headworks includes a magnetic-type flow meter to measure influent flow, a mechanically cleaned screen, a bypass channel with a bar screen, an influent sampler, and two cutthroat flumes to provide even flow distribution to the two aeration basins.

Secondary treatment consists of two aeration basins providing a complete mix activated sludge process... The repeated cycling of environments nitrifies and denitrifies the wastewater without recycle pumping or additional external basins.

Two 50-feet diameter, 16-feet side-water-depth secondary clarifiers remove the biomass associated with the secondary treatment process... The flocculation well... permits natural flocculation of the biomass contained in the mixed liquor.

Two RAS pumps at each clarifier return the settled sludge to the activated sludge process in order to maintain a viable population of the microorganisms responsible for the removal of the organic compounds present in wastewater.
A waste activated sludge (WAS) pump draws WAS from the RAS discharge piping and pumps the WAS to the biosolids storage basin.
A constant-speed submersible pump will be used to pump scum from the secondary clarifiers directly to the biosolids storage basin.
Secondary effluent can either flow by gravity or be pumped to the chlorine contact basins where chlorine solution is used to achieve disinfection and sulfur dioxide solution is used to dechlorinate.
Solids handling consists of pumping WAS from the secondary clarifiers to a biosolids storage basin.
The basin is scheduled to be dredged, dewatered, and dredged...
